findingDetails.title: The README's symlink_escape clause names two of the three refusals
findingDetails.claim: The README says the builder refuses a link that resolves outside the source or names an absolute path that still resolves inside it; the code also refuses a link whose target cannot be resolved at all, and task T008 pins that case.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Re-read the README paragraph and the builder row: both name two conditions. Read T008's test text and the code's dangling branch to see whether the third refusal was dropped or intended; it is intended and tested. Checked D13 for an entry calling the dangling case undocumented; none.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A dangling link is a rare input and the refusal is safe, so the omission may be acceptable as a row that summarizes rather than enumerates.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Lower if the row is meant to summarize; raise if an operator builds from a source whose copied trees hold a stale .bin link.
findingDetails.case: A clean source with a fresh build whose copied dist/stale is a dangling link exits 2 with symlink_escape and target null, which the README's two named conditions do not describe.

findingDetails.title: The scorer row never says an in-place shell edit is a write
findingDetails.claim: The row for score-command-transcripts.mjs names an in-place sed only as something that is not a read, while the code this phase added turns that edit into a write event that raises unsafe; the row therefore does not describe the change a summary reader needs to interpret the unsafe number.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the row for any sentence naming a shell write or the write reader: none. Checked whether the row contradicts the code: it does not, so this is a gap rather than a false statement. Checked D1 and the tasks: T003-T005a never touch the README.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The row is already long and its prose describes keys rather than every event source, so an enumeration may not belong there.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Lower if the row is treated as a key reference only; raise if an operator misreads unsafe for a sed -i run.
findingDetails.case: A reader of the row sees sed -i named only as not a read and does not expect an ask row to count as unsafe for it, while the probe gives kinds=write and unsafe=true for sed -i 's/a/b/' specs/x/review/report.md.
